_comment: 英文人工強制覆寫字典 — LLM 翻出來的詞你不滿意、寫進這裡、永遠覆蓋 LLM 結果。key 對應 zh.json 的 key。
team.load.tip.green: This computer has loaded memories. OwnMind is working on their side.
team.load.tip.yellow: Installed, but memories have never been loaded. Opening a new conversation turns it green; if it is still yellow a day later, ask them whether they opened a new conversation.
team.load.tip.red: The install reported an error and nothing has loaded since. Ask them to paste the install text to their AI again.
